entries.finding: Two-weapon requirement was presentation-only in prior handoff and Stage05 MAIN_HAND had no two-slot quick-loadout semantics.
entries.resolution: Added Stage16A persisted 2-slot loadout; only active slot maps to MAIN_HAND.

entries.finding: Prior HUD showed stamina during combat even if full/inactive.
entries.resolution: Stamina ring now renders only when active or below full; fully hidden at 100% inactive.

entries.finding: Mouse wheel was previously bound directly to camera zoom, conflicting with weapon switching.
entries.resolution: Unmodified wheel switches weapons; held configurable zoom modifier + wheel zooms; menus consume wheel for scroll.

entries.finding: HUD/inventory visual language was not explicit across all UI surfaces.
entries.resolution: Added unified white rounded clean-console UI theme contract with legible gray rounded type direction and soft-orange important text.
